narrative.overview: Spenles makes everyday financial information feel approachable and legible. The mobile app uses compact white surfaces, gentle borders, and ink-black actions. The desktop landing uses a centered three-phone introduction followed by reasons to use Spenles, feature stories, income and expense insights, and phone setup. The open S mark has no drawn wrapper in the interface; installed icons use a plain paper canvas.
keyCharacteristics: White and paper neutral surfaces with ink-black actions.
The open S mark appears without a drawn wrapper in the interface.
Financial colors carry meaning; ink carries brand and interaction.
Compact mobile task layouts and spacious desktop storytelling.

rules.name: The Accent Meaning Rule
rules.body: Reserve ink for brand, action, focus, and selected state; preserve income, expense, and warning colors for their semantic roles.

rules.name: The Amount Clarity Rule
rules.body: Give monetary figures clear contrast and tabular alignment; supporting labels remain visibly quieter.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use a border or surface shift first; reserve strong elevation for floating elements and focal previews.

dos: Do use shared Poppins, ink, white surfaces, and rounded controls when extending either surface.
Do keep financial figures stronger than supporting labels.
Do preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior when adding interactions.
donts: Don't use income, expense, or warning colors as arbitrary decoration.
Don't turn the spacious landing composition into the density standard for mobile tasks.
Don't add stronger shadows to every card; depth has a specific floating or focal purpose.
